hardRequirement: The released THC Living Plant Atlas specimen must read as a real photographed flowering cannabis plant, not a stylized, low-poly, plastic, generic, or visibly AI-deformed model.

criteria.label: Overall photographic realism
criteria.requirement: At normal desktop viewing distance the plant must plausibly read as a high-end photographed or scanned living flowering cannabis specimen.

criteria.label: Leaflet geometry and serration
criteria.requirement: Fan and sugar leaves must have believable cannabis leaflet proportions, taper, edge serration, curvature, petiole attachment, and non-repetitive natural variation.

criteria.label: Leaf surface and venation
criteria.requirement: Leaf surfaces, primary/secondary venation, thickness, translucency response, roughness, and color variation must avoid flat card, wax, rubber, or plastic appearance.

criteria.label: Nodes, internodes, and branching
criteria.requirement: Node spacing, branch origins, phyllotaxy cues, internode transitions, branch taper, and junctions must be botanically plausible and free of fused or floating geometry.

criteria.label: Stem texture and taper
criteria.requirement: Main stem and branches must show credible taper, surface texture, color variation, and mature plant structure without smooth toy-like cylinders.

criteria.label: Mature flower morphology
criteria.requirement: Flower clusters must show believable cannabis inflorescence architecture, bract density, pistil presence where appropriate, sugar-leaf integration, and non-generic blob structure.

criteria.label: Sugar leaves and resin character
criteria.requirement: Sugar leaves and flower surfaces must carry convincing resin/trichome character at close inspection without painted glitter, uniform noise, or exaggerated crystalline artifacts.

criteria.label: Exposed root architecture
criteria.requirement: The exposed root system must have a plausible crown, primary/structural roots, branching laterals, taper, fine-root transition, and integration with the stem base; no spaghetti bundles or decorative tendrils.

criteria.label: Material and PBR response
criteria.requirement: Materials must respond naturally to lighting with credible roughness, normal detail, translucency/alpha handling where needed, and no glossy plastic or metallic plant tissue.

criteria.label: Color and texture realism
criteria.requirement: Texture color, mottling, gradients, flower coloration, stems, roots, and microvariation must look natural under neutral lighting with no baked yellow cast or obvious procedural tiling.

criteria.label: No obvious AI or generation deformation
criteria.requirement: Reject fused leaves, impossible leaflet counts, duplicated motifs, melted flowers, branch discontinuities, impossible intersections, asymmetry caused by generation errors, or other obvious AI/model-generation defects.

criteria.label: No low-poly or cardboard read
criteria.requirement: Silhouette and close views must not expose coarse faceting, billboard-only foliage, visibly flat flower cards, chunky decimation, or game-prop simplification inconsistent with the Atlas target.

criteria.label: Full-plant multi-angle consistency
criteria.requirement: Front, rear, left, right, and top views must remain anatomically coherent with no hidden backside collapse or view-dependent geometry failure.

criteria.label: Mobile LOD fidelity
criteria.requirement: The mobile LOD may reduce hidden complexity and texture resolution but must preserve the realistic cannabis silhouette, leaf serration read, flowering structure, branch continuity, and root-system identity.

notes: AI-generated gallery candidate. It cannot advance from rights/technical eligibility to release eligibility until the downloaded geometry passes this full visual review.
